scripts.dev: echo "Run app-specific dev scripts after bootstrap"
scripts.build: echo "Run app-specific build scripts after bootstrap"
scripts.lint: echo "Run app-specific lint scripts after bootstrap"
scripts.ci:lint: pnpm --filter @snapspace/api lint:ci && pnpm --filter @snapspace/web lint:ci && pnpm --filter @snapspace/worker lint:ci
scripts.ci:typecheck: pnpm --filter @snapspace/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @snapspace/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @snapspace/worker typecheck
scripts.ci:build: pnpm --filter @snapspace/api build && pnpm --filter @snapspace/web build && pnpm --filter @snapspace/worker build
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm run ci:lint && pnpm run ci:typecheck && pnpm run ci:test && pnpm run ci:build
